description: §19.16.3 rule 3 — a failable deferred call handled in place with a TOTAL `!{}` handler (a variant arm plus the required `| _ :>` catch-all) is legal and its handler runs at exit: closeAll fails with Busy, the `::Busy` arm records it: trace = "work;close-busy;".
rationale: §19.16.3 rule 3: a failable call inside a deferred body is handled in place with a `!{}` handler that is total (it has a `_` arm, so a failure outside the declared enum cannot escape); the `!{}` binds to the deferred call, so it runs when the deferred body runs — at the block's exit.
